# OpenWallet Blog — Content Guide for LLMs

This file guides AI assistants on how to create well-structured blog posts for OpenWallet.

---

## File Location

All posts live in `/content/posts/<slug>.mdx`.
The filename becomes the URL slug: `gioi-thieu-openwallet.mdx` → `/blog/gioi-thieu-openwallet`

---

## Frontmatter Schema

```yaml
---
title: "String — full post title, shown in <h1> and <title> tag"
description: "1–2 sentence summary. Used in meta description and post header."
date: "YYYY-MM-DD"               # ISO date, used for sorting and display
author: "Author Name"            # Optional. Shown below the title.
category: "Hướng dẫn"           # MUST be one of: "Review thẻ" | "Hướng dẫn" | "Tin tức" | "So sánh thẻ"
tags:                            # Free-form tags: bank names, card names, topics, keywords, etc.
  - Vietcombank
  - thẻ tín dụng
  - hoàn tiền
ai_generated: true               # Optional. true = show ◇ AI badge. Omit for human-written posts.
card_slugs:                      # Optional. Card IDs from the catalog API.
  - bidv-visa-cashback-online    # These appear in the right sidebar as "Thẻ liên quan".
  - vpbank-stepup                # Only include cards directly relevant to the post content.
cover_image: "/images/..."       # Optional. Relative path to a cover image (not yet used in UI).
status: "published"              # "published" | "draft". Only "published" posts appear on site.
---
```

---

## Required Fields

| Field         | Required | Notes                                                        |
|---------------|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| `title`       | Yes      | Keep under 80 chars. Avoid clickbait.                        |
| `description` | Yes      | 120–160 chars. Used as meta description.                     |
| `date`        | Yes      | ISO 8601 format: `"2026-01-15"`                              |
| `category`    | Yes      | Must be one of the 4 fixed values. Do NOT invent new ones.  |
| `tags`        | Yes      | 2–8 free-form tags. Bank names, card names, topics, etc.    |
| `status`      | Yes      | Set to `"draft"` while writing, `"published"` when ready.   |

---

## Optional Fields

| Field          | Notes                                                                   |
|----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `author`        | Defaults to hidden if omitted.                                          |
| `ai_generated`  | Set to `true` when the post is written or summarised with AI assistance. Renders a ◇ AI badge next to the category pill on cards and in the post header. Omit or set `false` for human-written posts. **Always set this honestly.** |
| `card_slugs`    | Array of card IDs. Creates "Thẻ liên quan" sidebar. Get IDs from API:  |
|                 | `GET https://api.openwallet.vn/api/v1/cards` → use `id` field.         |
| `cover_image`   | Not currently displayed but reserved for future use.                    |

---

## Content Conventions

### Language
- Posts are written in **Vietnamese** (primary audience).
- Technical terms (API, JSON, Visa, Mastercard) stay in English.
- Monetary amounts: `200.000 VNĐ` or `200k`.

### Headings
- Use `##` for main sections, `###` for subsections, `####` sparingly.
- Do NOT use `#` (h1) — the post title is already rendered as h1.
- The Table of Contents is **auto-generated** from `##`, `###`, `####` headings.
- Heading text becomes anchor IDs via Vietnamese slugification:
  `"Bắt đầu sử dụng"` → `#bat-dau-su-dung`

### Links
- Internal links: use relative paths `/the/bidv-visa-classic` or `/ngan-hang/bidv`
- External links: absolute URLs with descriptive text

### Code blocks
- Use fenced code blocks with language identifier: ` ```json `, ` ```bash `

### Lists
- Prefer `- ` (dash) for unordered lists
- Numbered lists for step-by-step instructions

---

## Card Slugs

To find card IDs for `card_slugs`:
1. Call `GET https://api.openwallet.vn/api/v1/cards`
2. Filter by bank, network, or type using query params: `?bank_id=bidv&type=credit`
3. Use the `id` field (e.g. `"bidv-visa-cashback-online"`)

Cards in `card_slugs` are shown in the sidebar as linked cards with image, name, and type badges.
Only add cards that are **directly discussed** or **recommended** in the post.

---

## Categories

There are **exactly 4 categories**. You MUST use one of these values verbatim. Do NOT create new categories.

| Value           | Use for                                                              | Example titles |
|-----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| `Review thẻ`   | In-depth reviews of a specific card after real use                  | "Vietcombank Cashback Platinum: Có thực sự đáng không?", "Review MB Bank Visa Signature sau 6 tháng dùng thực tế" |
| `Hướng dẫn`    | How-to guides, tips, tutorials on using cards or managing finances  | "Top 5 thẻ tín dụng tốt nhất cho tín đồ Shopee", "Cách đọc sao kê thẻ tín dụng không bị nhầm", "Mở thẻ tín dụng đầu tiên: Nên chọn ngân hàng nào?" |
| `Tin tức`       | Banking industry news, new card launches, regulatory updates        | "Ngân hàng Nhà nước siết quy định hoàn tiền thẻ tín dụng 2025", "VPBank ra mắt thẻ mới dành riêng cho Gen Z" |
| `So sánh thẻ`  | Head-to-head comparisons between cards, networks, or strategies     | "Shopee Card vs VIB Online Plus: Mua sắm online chọn thẻ nào?", "Cashback vs Điểm thưởng: Loại thẻ nào lợi hơn cho bạn?" |

---

## Tags

Tags are **free-form** — use whatever is relevant to the post content. Good tag candidates:
- Bank names: `Vietcombank`, `MB Bank`, `VPBank`, `Techcombank`, `BIDV`, `VIB`, `TPBank`, `ACB`…
- Card names: `Visa Signature`, `Shopee Card`, `VIB Online Plus`…
- Topics: `hoàn tiền`, `cashback`, `điểm thưởng`, `phí thường niên`, `sao kê`, `Shopee`, `mua sắm online`…
- Card types: `thẻ tín dụng`, `thẻ ghi nợ`, `thẻ visa`, `thẻ mastercard`…

Use 2–8 tags per post. No restrictions on Vietnamese or English.

---

## Image Prompts

When writing a new post, always add an `image_prompts` field to the frontmatter.

### Keys

- The **`cover`** key maps to the cover image of the post.
- Every other key is the **filename stem** (without extension) of each image referenced in the post content.
- Keys double as filenames, so they must be **SEO-friendly**: descriptive, keyword-rich, hyphen-separated Vietnamese slugs.
- Use 3–6 words that describe the image subject and relate to the post topic.
- **Good:** `so-sanh-cashback-visa-vs-mastercard`, `bieu-phi-thuong-nien-the-tin-dung`, `cau-truc-so-the-ngan-hang-iso-7812`
- **Bad:** `image1`, `bang`, `hinh`, `cover2`

### Image paths in content

Images must follow this convention:

```
/images/posts/<slug>/<filename>.jpg
```

Use `.webp` as the default placeholder extension when writing (the admin server always converts uploads to WebP). Example:

```md
![Alt text](/images/posts/shopee-card-vs-vib-online-plus/so-sanh-cashback-shopee-card-vib-online-plus.webp)
```

### Gemini prompt guidelines

- Write prompts in **English**
- Be specific about visual style: "flat illustration", "minimalist", "infographic style", "isometric", etc.
- Mention a color tone that fits Vietnamese fintech: clean, professional, blue/green palette
- **No text in the image**
- Describe the subject clearly, related to the post topic
- Around 2–3 sentences per prompt

### Example frontmatter with image_prompts

```yaml
image_prompts:
  cover: "A flat-style minimalist illustration of two credit cards side by side, one labeled Visa and one Mastercard, clean blue and gold color palette, fintech style, no text."
  so-sanh-cashback-shopee-card-vib-online-plus: "A clean infographic-style comparison table visual with two columns, checkmarks and crosses, soft blue background, professional financial design, no text."
```

---

## Example Post

```mdx
---
title: "Shopee Card vs VIB Online Plus: Mua sắm online chọn thẻ nào?"
description: "So sánh chi tiết Shopee Card và VIB Online Plus về cashback, điều kiện và phí — giúp tín đồ mua sắm online chọn đúng thẻ."
date: "2026-02-10"
author: "OpenWallet Team"
category: "So sánh thẻ"
tags:
  - Shopee Card
  - VIB Online Plus
  - VIB
  - hoàn tiền
  - mua sắm online
  - thẻ tín dụng
card_slugs:
  - shopee-card
  - vib-online-plus-2
status: "published"
---

## Tổng quan

...

## So sánh cashback

### Shopee Card

...

### VIB Online Plus

...

## Kết luận
```
